title: Your material

subject.open_hint: Shows what there is for it
subject.topics_hint: Topics that came up in your questions.
subject.exercise_open_hint: Picks up where you left off
subject.empty_body: Photograph a sheet for it – then you'll find it here again.
subject.gone_body: Have a look at what else is in your material.

failure.unreadable: The photos were hard to read. Try more light and shoot from above.
failure.not_learning_material: That doesn't look like a worksheet, exercise book or textbook page.
failure.budget_exhausted: I can't read any more sheets today. It'll work again tomorrow.
failure.blocked: The safety filter won't let this sheet through. Reading it again won't help – just type the questions.
failure.form_not_practicable: I could read the sheet just fine – I just can't practise this kind of task with you. Ask me about it: I'll talk you through the steps.
failure.nothing_marked: I found nothing on the test marked as wrong – so there's nothing to practise. If something is marked in red after all, take the photo again.

source.corrected_test: From your corrected test: new tasks on what was marked – with other numbers and words.
source.notebook_entry: From your notebook entry: a few short questions on the last lesson – good for tomorrow morning.

incomplete_hint: The photos didn't fully arrive. Delete the sheet and photograph it again.
not_practicable_one: I left one task out: “{{tasks}}”. I can't practise that one with you – but I'll gladly explain how to go about it.
not_practicable_other: I left these tasks out: {{tasks}}. I can't practise those with you – but I'll gladly explain how to go about them.
photos_deleted: The photos are no longer stored. Delete the sheet and take new photos.

delete_sheet.title: Delete sheet?
delete_sheet.body: “{{title}}” and its questions will be deleted, and the photos too. This can't be undone.

empty.title: Your sheets end up here
empty.body: Photograph a worksheet, a textbook page or your exercise book – I'll turn it into practice.

items.reading: I'm reading the sheet right now – the questions will be here soon.
items.empty_body: You deleted all the questions from this sheet. Just take a new photo of it if you'd like to practise with it again.

item_delete_sheet.title: Delete question?
item_delete_sheet.body: This question won't come up again.
